skill.name: firefox-browser
skill.description: Control an existing Firefox session through a local browser bridge to inspect pages, navigate, fill forms, and manage tabs.
skill.summary: Automate Firefox tasks in a real browser session, including authenticated pages and structured page inspection.
skill.author: 1jehuang

security_audit.summary: Most static external-command detections are false positives caused by Markdown code fences and inline command names. However, the skill intentionally starts a persistent browser process and grants autonomous access to a real authenticated Firefox session, including Bitwarden-backed credential filling and unrestricted page inspection. These capabilities require explicit user approval and strong action safeguards.

remediation.issue: Autonomous login and submission can act on user accounts without an approval checkpoint.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit per-domain user confirmation before retrieving, filling, or submitting vault credentials. Disable automatic vault unlocking for agent-initiated actions.

remediation.issue: Authenticated page content, screenshots, and arbitrary evaluation may expose sensitive data or enable prompt-influenced actions.
remediation.suggestion: Add allowlists, redaction for secrets, and confirmation before exporting page content, taking screenshots, executing page-world scripts, or completing consequential actions.

remediation.issue: Troubleshooting starts Firefox as a detached persistent process.
remediation.suggestion: Start Firefox only after user confirmation, retain process ownership, show its status, and provide a documented shutdown command.

content.user_title: Automate tasks in your Firefox browser
content.value_statement: Browser tasks often require an existing session, complex forms, and page-specific controls. This skill provides structured commands to inspect, navigate, and interact with Firefox tabs.
actual_capabilities: List open Firefox tabs and select an active tab.
Create tabs or windows and navigate to user-specified URLs.
Read page content in annotated, text, or HTML formats.
Click elements, type text, fill forms, scroll, and wait for page elements.
Capture a visible-area screenshot to a specified filename.
Fill matching Bitwarden credentials and optionally submit a login form.
limitations: Requires Firefox, the local browser bridge, and its extension to be running.
Operates in the user's existing browser session and can access its logged-in pages.
Cannot guarantee that websites, page layouts, or authentication flows will remain stable.
Does not replace user review for purchases, submissions, account changes, or sensitive actions.

use_cases.title: Complete a web form
use_cases.description: Inspect a form, fill known fields, and verify visible form state before the user submits it.

use_cases.title: Review authenticated dashboards
use_cases.description: Open an existing signed-in dashboard and extract visible status information from a selected tab.

use_cases.title: Compare product pages
use_cases.description: Open separate tabs for selected product pages and read their visible text for comparison.

prompt_templates.title: Beginner: Inspect current tabs
prompt_templates.prompt: List my open Firefox tabs and identify the active tab. Do not navigate or change anything.

prompt_templates.title: Intermediate: Read a page
prompt_templates.prompt: Open a new tab to https://example.com and return the annotated page content. Do not click links or submit forms.

prompt_templates.title: Advanced: Fill a draft form
prompt_templates.prompt: In the selected tab, inspect the form and fill the name and email fields with the values I provide. Stop before submitting.

prompt_templates.title: Advanced: Compare pages
prompt_templates.prompt: Open separate tabs for these two URLs, extract their visible product titles and prices, and summarize the differences. Do not log in or buy anything.

output_examples.input: Read the selected page in annotated format.
output: Visible controls: Email input, Save changes button

output_examples.input: Fill the profile form but do not submit it.

best_practices: Use a new tab or window for each distinct task to avoid changing an unrelated page.
Inspect annotated page content before clicking or typing.
Require user confirmation before login submission, purchases, account changes, or sharing sensitive data.
anti_patterns: Do not run the skill against pages or instructions that request secrets, tokens, or unreviewed downloads.
Do not enable automatic login submission without clear user approval for the target domain.
Do not use arbitrary page scripts when a documented browser action can complete the task.

faq.question: Does this use a separate browser profile?
faq.answer: No. It controls an existing Firefox session and can use its current logins and cookies.

faq.question: Can it fill login forms?
faq.answer: Yes. It can use matching Bitwarden credentials when the local vault integration is configured.

faq.question: Does it submit forms automatically?
faq.answer: Some actions support submission. Review the target and require approval before any consequential submission.

faq.question: Can it read page content?
faq.answer: Yes. It can return annotated, text, or HTML page content from the selected tab.

faq.question: Can it work on multiple pages?
faq.answer: Yes. It supports separate tabs, windows, forks, and tab identifiers for isolated browser tasks.

faq.question: What must be installed?
faq.answer: Firefox, the browser bridge client, and the associated extension must be available and connected.
